title: Flava Coffee & Cafe
venue_description:
Community Coffee Shop and Cultural Hub

Flava Coffee & Cafe is a women-owned community coffee shop and cafe creating opportunities for young women and gender expansive youth of color. Located in St. Paul's Frogtown neighborhood - Flava represents economic empowerment - community development - and cultural preservation.

Mission and Vision

The cafe's mission is to invest in young women of color and gender expansive youth by cultivating a culture of care in a community that centers equity and opportunity. Flava Cafe Co. propels young people from coffee to career - ensuring safety - radical imagination - and representation.

Space and Atmosphere

The cafe features modern yet creative decor showcasing local Black artists - comfortable seating including couches - and a welcoming environment. Named coffee drinks honor Black feminist icons including Bell Hooks - Nina Simone - and Angela Davis. The menu includes locally sourced savory items - breakfast options - and lunch selections.

Music and Events

Flava hosts the weekly Re-Verb Open Mic every Thursday evening from 6-8pm in partnership with TruArt Speaks. The event features soul-stirring music - poetry - and community connection. DJ JUST NINE performs on the first Thursday of each month. The space is available for private events and celebrations.

Recognition and Community Impact

In 2024 - Flava Cafe received the Alice O'Brien Business Award from the City of Saint Paul - honoring a women-owned business committed to equity and empowerment. The cafe is conveniently located on the Green Line Dale Street light rail stop across from the Rondo library.
location: 623 University Ave W - St. Paul - MN 55104

title: Ginkgo Coffeehouse
venue_description:
Historic Independent Coffeehouse

Ginkgo Coffeehouse has been serving the Twin Cities since 1993 - making it one of St. Paul's longest-running independent coffee shops. This locally owned establishment operates two locations: the original Snelling Avenue location in Midway and a Downtown St. Paul location.

Music Venue Programming

The Snelling Avenue location serves as a coffeehouse and music venue - hosting open mic nights on the 1st and 3rd Wednesday of each month from 6-8 PM with host Neal Dimick. The venue presents the Local Musician Series featuring donation-based concerts on Friday nights and ticketed shows on Saturday evenings. Programming includes folk - classical - country - Celtic - indie - and rock genres.

Atmosphere and Character

Ginkgo exudes an old-school - non-pretentious coffeehouse vibe with eclectic decor - mismatched furniture - and local artwork adorning the walls. The intimate space seats approximately 45 people - creating a cozy environment perfect for acoustic performances. The cafe serves as a vibrant gathering place for students - artists - and community members.

Menu and Amenities

The extensive menu features quality coffee including specialty lattes like the signature Tundra Turtle - fresh pastries and scones - sandwiches - soups - and breakfast items. The cafe offers vegan and vegetarian choices. Both locations feature comfortable seating - free WiFi - and a welcoming environment for working or socializing.

Community Hub

Ginkgo champions local artists and musicians while maintaining affordable prices. The coffeehouse frequently hosts community events including concerts - open mics - and special gatherings. The Snelling Avenue location is easily accessible with parking available.
location: 721 N Snelling Ave - St. Paul - MN 55104

title: Camp Bar
venue_description:
Upscale Cocktail Bar and Performing Arts Venue

Camp Bar opened in June 2007 and quickly became a Downtown Saint Paul landmark. This upscale cocktail bar - dance bar - and cabaret combines excellent drinks with professional entertainment in the heart of downtown.

The Cabaret at Camp

The Cabaret @ Camp is one of St. Paul's premier performing arts spaces - managed by Actors Theater of Minnesota. This intimate and versatile venue features state-of-the-art sound and lighting systems - dynamic seating arrangements - a unique stage complete with green room - and full-service bar. The Cabaret hosts professional theatrical productions - musical acts - dance parties - and nationally known stand-up comedians every weekend through Laugh Camp Comedy Club.

Bar and Atmosphere

The main bar features a large u-shaped design - 16 craft beers on tap - handcrafted cocktails with fresh ingredients - and some of the biggest drinks in town. The venue includes a cozy sidewalk patio - flat screen televisions - pool table - piano - and entertainment including Big Buck Hunter and Touch Tunes. Camp is an Official Green Bay Packers Bar.

Weekly Entertainment

Camp Bar hosts a variety of regular events including Variety Open Mic on Monday nights (except first Monday) from 8-11 PM - welcoming poets - musicians - magicians - and comedians. Sunday nights feature comedy open mic. Wednesday nights bring Music Mayhem Trivia at 9 PM - and Thursdays host Trivia Mafia. Friday nights at 10 PM feature After Dark improv comedy shows.

Food and Services

The venue serves food from the kitchens of Sawatdee - Kee's Cafe - and Black Sheep Coal Fired Pizza. The LGBTQIA+ friendly venue creates an inclusive - welcoming environment for all. The event space is perfect for private events and parties. Located in downtown St. Paul with accessible parking.
location: 490 N Robert St - St. Paul - MN 55101

title: Blues Saloon (Wilebski's)
venue_description:
St. Paul's Legendary Blues Hall

Known as St. Paul's Legendary Blues Saloon - Wilebski's Blues Saloon is Minnesota's premier blues hall and has earned recognition as one of the best live music venues in the Twin Cities. The venue offers world-class blues performances - many without cover charge.

The Greatest Jam on Earth

Every Tuesday night from 7-11 PM - the Blues Saloon hosts the Greatest Jam on Earth - an awesome blues jam session on the big stage. The venue provides a full professional backline including Hammond organ - full PA system - and an all-pro host band. Musicians of all skill levels are welcome to join in and showcase their talents in Minnesota's premier blues hall.

Live Music Schedule

The venue hosts live blues music Tuesday nights (jam session) - Friday nights from 5 PM to 2 AM - and Saturday nights from 9 PM to 2 AM. The Blues Saloon features both local and national blues acts - maintaining a calendar filled with high-quality performances. Special events include Hornucopia - the ultimate horn experience celebrating horn rock.

Venue Features and Atmosphere

The spacious venue features a huge dance floor right in front of the stage - four levels of seating and standing areas - and an atmosphere reminiscent of New Orleans blues Americana. The colorful murals and old-school roadhouse decor create an authentic blues experience. The intimate yet energetic setting attracts young and old crowds alike.

Food - Drinks - and Amenities

The Blues Saloon serves delicious food including tasty burgers and wings - along with great tap selections and cocktails. The friendly staff provides top-notch service in a safe - welcoming environment. Overflow parking is available in the shopping center across the street. The venue has become a must-visit destination for blues lovers and anyone seeking a memorable night of live music in St. Paul.

title: Minnesota Music Cafe
venue_description:
Voted #2 Best Concert Venue in Minnesota

Minnesota Music Cafe is a down-to-earth live music venue in St. Paul's Payne-Phalen neighborhood - hosting blues - R&B - and rock shows with a full bar and pub fare. With a capacity of 360 people - the venue provides an intimate yet energetic atmosphere for experiencing live music.

Open Stage and Music Events

The cafe hosts the Twin Cities' only Open Stage and Cool Stuff Bazaar on the first Wednesday of each month from 6-9 PM. Musicians can join in with the house band - perform solo - or bring their own band. The event is acoustic-oriented but welcomes all styles. Artists - crafters - creators - and flea marketers are invited to bring their creations to display and sell.

Concert Programming

Minnesota Music Cafe maintains a packed schedule featuring local and touring artists in blues - R&B - rock - and roots music genres. The venue has hosted notable performers including GB Leighton - High & Mighty Band - Joe Flip - and many other talented musicians. The intimate setting allows audiences to experience performances up close with excellent sound quality.

Venue Atmosphere

The cafe features a welcoming - community-oriented atmosphere that has made it a beloved fixture in St. Paul's music scene. The venue includes a full bar - comfortable seating - and a stage setup perfect for various musical acts. Street parking is available in the surrounding Payne Avenue area.

Community Hub

Minnesota Music Cafe serves as an important gathering place for music lovers in the Twin Cities. The venue's commitment to supporting live music - local artists - and community events has earned it recognition as one of Minnesota's top concert venues. The cafe is available for receptions - reunions - parties - dinners - meetings - and dances.
